title: 第一万一百一十七章 天地移位第一万一百一十六章 山中之门
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：道界天下正文第一万一百一十七章天地移位（..la）门内，是一片黑暗！
没有星辰，没有界缝，没有任何可以被称之为“有”的东西，只有一片纯粹的，无边无际的虚无。
而在这片虚无之中，却又悬浮着一团又一团的灰白色的光芒。
它们数量不多，只有数百而已。
体积虽然大小不等，但都不大。
大的光芒只有巴掌大小，而小的光芒则是只有指甲大小。
所有的光芒就仿若是星辰一般，杂乱无章的散落在这片黑暗的各处，一动不动。
而每一团光芒的内部，都悬浮着一块碎片！
这些碎片，有的是如同影子一般，有的却是凝实的状态，形状各异，其上有着数道斑驳的纹路。
如果姜云和姬空凡能够看到这些碎片的话，他们必然会无比震惊。
因为，这些碎片，和此时此刻姬空凡牢牢握在手中的那一块碎片，不管是上面覆盖的纹路，还是构成的材质，都是极为的相似！
男子的目光，扫过眼前的这些碎片之后，便落在了其中一块碎片之上。
这是一块三角形的碎片虚影，只有指甲大小。
其周身环绕的光芒之上，有着一道道无之痕正在不断翻涌，如同在对着男子发出召唤一般。
“就是你！”
男子微微一笑，开口说话的同时，已经一步踏出，来到了这块碎片的旁边，伸出手来，虚虚的握住了这块碎片。
刹那间，那块碎片的光芒骤然大作！
灰白的光芒从碎片的深处喷涌而出，将它所在方圆丈许范围内的黑暗，都照亮了开来，竟然渐渐的映照出了一幕景象。
清晰可见，那是一方天地，上方还笼罩着一层翻滚的劫云。
“找到位置了！”

男子笑着开口，松开手掌，再次朝着后方迈步，走出了这扇门，站在了门前，猛然挥动大袖。
“轰隆隆！”
伴随着一阵惊天动地的轰鸣之声响起，男子面前这扇顶天立地，嵌于山岳深处的门，蓦然间开始了疯狂暴涨。
诡异的是，它明明是凝实的状态，但当它膨胀时，山体的岩石，无之痕的封印，竟然对它构不成任何的阻碍。
它就像是一道投在石壁上的影子，无声无息地穿过了整座山体。
山石完好无损，禁制纹丝未动，而门却已经从山的内部膨胀到了山体之外。
门，继续膨胀！
几息之后，它便已经赫然穿过了这方天地的壁垒，如同一道从虚无中生长出来的灰白巨幕，矗立在天地之外那片翻涌的混沌之中。
而青衫男子收回手掌，又是一步踏出，整个人同样站在了天地之外，向着这方天地轻轻挥了挥衣袖。
下一刻，整方天地，赫然动了起来！
天地竟然开始向着那扇以修士的肉身和魂炼化而成的门中，缓缓移动。
那画面壮观到了极点，也诡异到了极点——
一方包含了无数星辰、无尽生灵、无尽岁月的浩大世界，如同一幅被无形之手缓缓卷起的画卷，一点一点地没入那扇灰白的巨门之中。
天地之内，星辰世界，无尽生灵，却是依旧保持着原先的状态，根本没有人能够察觉到这扇门的出现，也没有人有任何异样的感觉。
当最后一片天地的边缘没入门扉，整方天地便彻底消失在了门中。
而那扇门依旧静静地矗立在混沌之中，门扉之上流转的灰白光芒微微闪烁了一下，像是在确认什么，然后便开始缓缓合拢。
男子面带笑容，同样踏入了门中。
大门无声无息地关闭，连同其内刚刚容纳的整方天地，以及那个青衫男子，一并从原处消失了。
与此同时，姜云所在的太初山内。
在用尽所有力气，劈开了器灵布下的层层封印和九宫阵图之后，姜云顾不上查看自己的情况，顾不上看看手中的那柄刀，而是急忙来到了姬空凡的身旁。

“姬前辈，您怎么样？”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chapter 1117 of the main text of Daojie Tianxia (The Shift of Heaven and Earth (..la)) Inside the door, there is darkness!
There are no stars, no boundaries, nothing that can be called "being", just pure, boundless nothingness.
And in this void, there are groups of gray-white lights suspended.
There aren't many of them, just a few hundred.
Although the sizes vary, they are not large.
The large light is only the size of a palm, while the small light is only the size of a fingernail.
All the rays of light were like stars, scattered chaotically throughout the darkness, motionless.
And inside every ball of light, there is a fragment suspended!
Some of these fragments are like shadows, while others are in a solid state, with different shapes and several mottled lines on them.
If Jiang Yun and Ji Kongfan could see these fragments, they would be extremely shocked.
Because these fragments are very similar to the fragment Ji Kongfan is holding firmly in his hand at this moment, both in terms of the patterns covered on them and the materials they are made of!
After scanning the fragments in front of him, the man's eyes fell on one of them.
It was a triangular fragment, about the size of a fingernail.
On the light surrounding it, there are traces of nothingness that are constantly surging, as if calling to the man.
"That's you!"
The man smiled slightly, and while speaking, he took a step forward and came to the side of the fragment. He stretched out his hand and held the fragment in vain.
In an instant, the fragment suddenly burst into light!
Gray light spurted out from the depths of the fragment, illuminating the darkness within a few feet of its location, and gradually revealed a scene.
It was clearly visible that it was a piece of heaven and earth, with a layer of rolling clouds of calamity hanging above it.
"Found the location!"
The man spoke with a smile, released his palms, stepped back again, walked out of the door, stood in front of the door, and suddenly waved his sleeves.
"Boom!"
Along with an earth-shattering roar, the door in front of the man that stood tall and was embedded in the depths of the mountain suddenly began to surge wildly.
The strange thing is that it is obviously in a solid state, but when it expands, the rocks of the mountain and the traceless seal do not pose any obstacle to it.
It was like a shadow cast on the stone wall, passing through the entire mountain silently.
The rocks were intact and the prohibition remained intact, but the door had expanded from the inside of the mountain to the outside.
The door continues to expand!
A few breaths later, it had already passed through the barrier of this side of the world, like a giant gray screen growing out of nothingness, standing in the turbulent chaos outside the world.
The man in green shirt retracted his palm, took another step forward, and stood outside the world, gently waving his sleeves towards the world.
The next moment, the whole world suddenly started to move!
The world actually began to move slowly towards the door that was refined with the monk's body and soul.
The scene was spectacular to the extreme, and also weird to the extreme——
A vast world containing countless stars, endless creatures, and endless years, like a picture scroll slowly rolled up by invisible hands, submerged bit by bit into the giant gray door.
Within the heaven and earth, the world of stars, and the countless creatures, they still maintain their original state. No one can notice the appearance of this door, and no one has any strange feeling.
When the edge of the last piece of heaven and earth entered the door, the entire world completely disappeared inside the door.
And that door still stood quietly in the chaos. The gray light flowing above the door flickered slightly, as if to confirm something, and thenThen it began to close slowly.
The man also stepped into the door with a smile on his face.
The door closed silently, and together with the entire world it had just accommodated, as well as the man in green shirt, disappeared from their place.
At the same time, Jiang Yun was in Taichu Mountain.
After using all his strength to split open the layers of seals and the Nine Palaces Formation under the Weapon Spirit Cloth, Jiang Yun did not bother to check his own situation or the knife in his hand, but hurriedly came to Ji Kongfan's side.
"Senior Ji, how are you?"
